about: Announced openings that are NOT open yet (restaurants, cafés & bars, coffee, bakeries). Shown on the site under New → Opening soon. expectedOpening = YYYY-MM-DD | YYYY-MM | YYYY | "soon"; once that date/period has passed (Europe/Brussels, computed in the browser) the record shows as "Just opened" until it is moved into brussel.json (see update.md). Unknown fields are null; nothing invented. `opening: 'YYYY-MM'` is accepted as an alias of expectedOpening. Cards show 'Opening soon · <Month>' (year added beyond the next 3 months); once the month has passed the place shows as 'New since <Month YYYY>' automatically.

upcoming.name: Jeanne (Kanal)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Opens with Kanal–Centre Pompidou on 28 Nov 2026; Wed-Thu 19:00-24:00, Fri-Sat 17:30-24:00 (kitchen until 21:00).
upcoming.description: Kanal's vegetarian gastronomic restaurant overlooking the showroom: chef Aurélia D'Hollander (ex Frondes, Ivresse) serves a seasonal tasting menu of 6 courses (€95) or 4 (€75, first Fri/Sat sitting) at long shared tables by an open kitchen; named after Chantal Akerman's Jeanne Dielman.

upcoming.name: Carrosserie (Kanal)
upcoming.address: Quai des Péniches 11, 1000 Bruxelles (Kanal, ground floor)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Opens with Kanal on 28 Nov 2026; Wed-Sun 12:00-24:00, continuous service.
upcoming.description: Kanal's waterside brasserie with a big terrace and a 'pimped' modern brasserie menu by chef Peter Macias: roasted pumpkin with Ardennes buffalo mozzarella, crispy North Sea skate, bitterballen and Belgian classics.

upcoming.name: GIO
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: Bruzz/L'Echo (22 Oct 2026): opens early November, after Senzanome closes on 31 October.
upcoming.description: Giovanni Bruno closes his long-starred Senzanome on the Sablon after 35 years and opens a simpler, more affordable trattoria a few dozen metres away, with the Senzanome team invited along.

upcoming.name: Lost Frequencies restaurant (ex-Toucan sur Mer, name TBA)
upcoming.address: Avenue Louis Lepoutre, 1050 Ixelles (former Toucan sur Mer)
upcoming.expectedOpeningNote: L'Echo via BX1 (2 Sep 2026): opening planned end of January 2027; HLN (5 Sep 2026): partner Cameron Heal says 'probably spring 2027'.
upcoming.description: DJ Lost Frequencies (Felix De Laet), Hangar's Marvin Weymeersch and Cameron Heal, and Victor Roisin (Gratin, Moutarde) take over the seafood institution Toucan sur Mer, closed in June: new name, new chef, Mediterranean menu and occasional chill DJ sets.
